entity.name: EoS Foundation
entity.description: EoS Foundation is a 501(c)(3) public charity building free, open-source embedded systems infrastructure. Our flagship project, EoS, is a production-grade real-time operating system written in pure C11 under the MIT license. The kernel fits in 15.8 KB of flash and 26.0 KB of RAM on a Cortex-M4, yet supports 171 microcontroller families through our eBuild build system. We maintain 23 repositories totaling roughly 500,000 lines of code, including eBoot (a secure two-stage bootloader with AES and SHA-256/512), EoSim (a simulator covering 153 platforms), eCAD (hardware designs for 125 product lines), and 14 free technical books. Our team of 20-50 volunteer contributors operates with zero full-time employees and under $15,000 in annual revenue. We have a Linux Foundation partnership. EIN: 41-4821627.

projects.name: EoS - Embedded Operating System
projects.description: A production-grade, formally verifiable real-time operating system in pure C11. EoS provides a minimal, secure kernel (15.8 KB flash, 26.0 KB RAM on Cortex-M4) with preemptive multitasking, inter-process communication, and memory protection. The project includes eBuild (a build system supporting 171 MCU families and 84 board descriptors), eBoot (a secure two-stage bootloader implementing AES-128/256, SHA-256/512, with RSA and ECC signature verification in development), EoSim (a cross-platform simulator for 153 target platforms), and eCAD (open hardware designs for 125 product lines including 15 development boards and 4 health monitoring devices at design stage). All software is MIT-licensed.
